title: Citrus Harvesting Robot: an open, low-cost 3D-printed tracked robot platform for selective orange harvesting
description: Open-hardware design of a low-cost tracked mobile robot for selective, single-fruit orange harvesting, organised as a layered IoT architecture. Includes the FreeCAD source model, printable STL files, assembly guides, bill of materials and a design log. Developed for an undergraduate thesis in Information Systems at IFSULDEMINAS, Campus Machado, Brazil (2026).
